_provenance: Hand-digitized generalized polylines, session e3137278 (2026-07-25), DENSIFIED in build 2 so the neck-plate water reads as continuous water bodies (the build-1 acceptance blocker). These features are absent from Natural Earth 10m at plate grain (NE 10m rivers return ZERO features inside the neck bbox: no Kiel Canal, Schlei, Eider, Treene). Per map-spec.md the sanctioned fallback is hand-digitizing at generalized ~1:500k grain from PD sources / public geographic knowledge, marked GUESS, disclosed. Endpoints are anchored to atlas node coordinates where a node exists (Rendsburg, Schleswig, Friedrichstadt, Lubeck...). NO copyrighted or scanned map was traced; these are coarse traces from public geographic knowledge. The `half_km` property on a water feature is the GUESS-tier half-width in km used to draw it as a filled water ribbon (a scalar, or a per-vertex list tapering the fjord); the renderer converts it to points at each plate's own scale, so the same feature is a thin line on the theater plate and a legible water body on the neck plate. Cartographically the canal is drawn a touch wider than true scale so it does not vanish. TIER: GUESS throughout. The Danevirke trace follows reference/danevirke.md (Schlei head WSW to the Treene marshes, ~19 km, facing south).
